reference_policy: No private text-task shape target; images compare public visible content; edits compare frozen before/target within permitted scope.
focus:
铁匠铺：恢复炉台与锻造设备；精确数值由程序测量；
Restore a furnace basin with a rim and recessed interior below the canopy; Restore a recognizable bellows with coherent volume and connection; Restore an anvil with horn, waist, stand and visible fixing/support; Include the two heated iron pieces in their intended work area; Keep tools/building/workspace readable with limited warm heated accents, not an unrelated redesign. Read the original edit scope. Existing background defects are not new edit defects. Exact dimensions and light controls remain automatic.
